title: About
text:
This a page about me. My name is Ivy, born and raise in Taipei Taiwan.


I’m a detail-oriented business analyst with a solid background in international business and finance. My experience in the finance and supply chain sectors has given me the ability to transform raw data into actionable insights. With strong analytical skills and cultural awareness, I’ve successfully navigated diverse markets, identifying opportunities even in challenging environments.
